moresteam.configuration.title: More Steam
moresteam.configuration.steamDurationMul: How much longer bogeys release steam after a train stops. 1.0 is Create's own duration.
moresteam.configuration.idleSteam.toolti: Whether the cylinders of a standing train with a firebox let off a burst of steam every now and then.
Shortest wait before a standing train's cylinder lets off a burst.
Longest wait before a standing train's cylinder lets off a burst.
How long each burst of a standing train lasts.
moresteam.configuration.pullAwaySteam.to: Whether the cylinders of a train with a firebox let off bursts as it pulls away from a standstill.
moresteam.configuration.pullAwayInterval: Shortest wait between a cylinder's bursts while the train pulls away.
Longest wait between a cylinder's bursts while the train pulls away.
moresteam.configuration.pullAwayBurstLen: How long each burst lasts while the train pulls away.
moresteam.configuration.pullAwayCutoff.t: Speed, as a fraction of the train's top speed, at which the pull-away bursts stop until the next standstill.
moresteam.configuration.soundRange.toolt: How far away the cylinder bursts can be heard. Minecraft's own sounds use 16.
moresteam.configuration.steamAxleBase.to: Steam = base ^ (axles - 2). WARNING: at 3.0 a six-axle bogey makes 81x the steam and can wreck the frame rate.
